metadata.scenario: A longtime subscriber reaches out to resolve a billing error, claiming a subscription renewal fee was unjustly charged. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi, Margaret. This is Mary O'Connor. I need to discuss a billing issue I just noticed. Of course, Mary. I’m here to help. What seems to be the problem? So, I was charged a subscription renewal fee, but I don’t think I authorized that. I understand your concern. Let me pull up your account. Can you hold for just a moment? Yes, no problem. Thank you for your patience, Mary. I see here that you were charged $150 for your subscription renewal last week. This is typically for ongoing IV therapy support. I see that, but I didn't mean to renew it. I thought it was more of an ongoing service without additional charges. I apologize for the confusion. The renewal is set to auto-charge unless cancelled. I understand that now, but I still don’t think I should have been charged. I completely understand your frustration, Mary. Let’s resolve this for you. Thank you, I appreciate that. I can submit a request for a billing dispute and have our billing department review the charge. That would be great. How long will that take? Typically, it takes 3-5 business days for the review process. Okay, I can wait that long. In the meantime, would you be interested in discussing additional supportive services? I might be. What do you have in mind? We offer services like transportation for medical appointments and additional personal care assistance that could help you. That does sound helpful, actually. Can you send me more information? Absolutely, I can have our Care Coordinator, Lisa, reach out to you with details. Perfect. Thank you! I’ll also follow up with you once the billing issue is addressed. Thank you, Margaret. That really eases my mind. You’re welcome, Mary. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? No, that’s everything. Thanks again! Thank you for calling, Mary. Have a great day! You too! Goodbye. Goodbye!
